name: Line Item 13
definition: Commercial details of a trade transaction between a buyer and a seller.

GoodsAndOrServicesDescription.name: Goods And Or Services Description
GoodsAndOrServicesDescription.definition: Information about the goods and/or services of a trade transaction.

PartialShipment.name: Partial Shipment
PartialShipment.definition: Indicates whether or not partial shipments are allowed.

TransShipment.name: Trans Shipment
TransShipment.definition: Indicates whether or not transshipment of goods is allowed.

ShipmentDateRange.name: Shipment Date Range
ShipmentDateRange.definition: Specifies an earliest shipment date and a latest shipment date.

LineItemDetails.name: Line Item Details
LineItemDetails.definition: Goods or services that are purchased.

LineItemsTotalAmount.name: Line Items Total Amount
LineItemsTotalAmount.definition: Specifies the total amount of all line items (incl. their adjustments).

RoutingSummary.name: Routing Summary
RoutingSummary.definition: Information related to the conveyance of goods.

Incoterms.name: Incoterms
Incoterms.definition: Specifies the applicable Incoterms and associated location. Latest version of Incoterms in effect at the date of message creation.

Adjustment.name: Adjustment
Adjustment.definition: Variance on price for the goods.

FreightCharges.name: Freight Charges
FreightCharges.definition: Maximum charges related to the conveyance of goods.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters linked to the value of the goods in a trade transaction.

TotalNetAmount.name: Total Net Amount
TotalNetAmount.definition: Total net amount of a trade transaction. Total amount resulting from the gross amount plus freight charges, tax and plus/minus Adjustments.

BuyerDefinedInformation.name: Buyer Defined Information
BuyerDefinedInformation.definition: Information important for the users of the message/service, which cannot be captured in any other message component/element. For example: Warehouse number.

SellerDefinedInformation.name: Seller Defined Information
SellerDefinedInformation.definition: Information important for the users of the message/service, which cannot be captured in any other message component/element. For example: Warehouse number.

LatestShipmentDateRule.definition: If LatestShipmentDate is present, then LatestShipmentDate is not allowed within each occurrence of LineItemDetails. If LatestShipmentDate is not present, then LatestShipmentDate is allowed within each occurrence of LineItemDetails.

RoutingSummaryRule.definition: If RoutingSummary is present, then RoutingSummary is not allowed within each occurrence of LineItemDetails. If RoutingSummary is not present, then RoutingSummary is allowed within each occurrence of LineItemDetails.

IncotermsRule.definition: If Incoterms is present, then Incoterms is not allowed within each occurrence of LineItemDetails. If Incoterms is not present, then Incoterms is allowed within each occurrence of LineItemDetails.

AdjustmentFreightChargesAndTaxRule.definition: Adjustments, freight charges and taxes must be entered at this level, or adjustments, freight charges and taxes must be entered at line item level.
